# Sapphire UI v1.0.9 — Exemplos dos Novos Componentes

Este documento demonstra todos os novos recursos de UI introduzidos na v1.0.9.

---

## 1. `Card` — Container com Gradiente e Sombra

```sp
var UI = 1

function updateUI() {
    var app = Flex(
        style="AppBg",
        direction="column",
        align="center",
        gap=20.0,
        children=[
            Card(
                label="Bem-vindo",
                gradientFrom="#3B0764",
                gradientTo="#1E1B4B",
                gradientDir="vertical",  // "vertical" | "horizontal"
                shadowBlur=12.0,
                shadowColor="#8B5CF660",
                shadowOffsetY=8.0,
                glowColor="#A78BFA",     // halo no hover
                width=300.0,
                height=140.0
            )
        ]
    )
    var event = Render(app)
    if (event != nil) { event() }
    return true
}

Style("AppBg", bgColor="#0F0F1A", textColor="#E2E8F0", borderThickness=0.0)

```

## 4. `Stepper` — Indicador de Etapas

```sp
var UI = 1
var step = 0

function next() { if (step < 3) { step = step + 1 } }
function prev() { if (step > 0) { step = step - 1 } }

function updateUI() {
    var app = Flex(
        direction="column",
        gap=20.0,
        align="center",
        children=[
            Stepper(
                id="wizard",
                steps=4,
                current=step,
                width=400.0,
                height=50.0,
                labels=["Conta", "Perfil", "Segurança", "Concluir"]
            ),
            Flex(direction="row", gap=10.0, children=[
                Button(label="← Voltar",  width=120.0, height=36.0, onClick=prev),
                Button(label="Avançar →", width=120.0, height=36.0, onClick=next)
            ])
        ]
    )
    var event = Render(app)
    if (event != nil) { event() }
    return true
}


```

---

## 5. `Spinner` — Arco Giratório Animado

O Spinner gira automaticamente a 280°/s — não precisa de `Animate()`.

```sp
var UI = 1

function updateUI() {
    var app = Flex(
        direction="row",
        gap=20.0,
        align="center",
        children=[
            Spinner(id="s1", width=60.0, height=60.0, thickness=6.0, color="#8B5CF6"),
            Spinner(id="s2", width=40.0, height=40.0, thickness=4.0, color="#60A5FA"),
            Spinner(id="s3", width=28.0, height=28.0, thickness=3.0, color="#34D399")
        ]
    )
    var event = Render(app)
    if (event != nil) { event() }
    return true
}


```

---

## 6. `Notify` — Toast de Notificação

```sp
var UI = 1

function onSuccess() { Notify("Salvo com sucesso!", "success") }
function onError()   { Notify("Erro ao processar.",  "error")   }
function onWarn()    { Notify("Campo obrigatório.",   "warning") }
function onInfo()    { Notify("Atualização disponível.", "info") }

function updateUI() {
    var app = Flex(
        direction="column",
        gap=12.0,
        align="center",
        children=[
            Button(label="Sucesso",  width=160.0, height=40.0, onClick=onSuccess),
            Button(label="Erro",     width=160.0, height=40.0, onClick=onError),
            Button(label="Aviso",    width=160.0, height=40.0, onClick=onWarn),
            Button(label="Info",     width=160.0, height=40.0, onClick=onInfo)
        ]
    )
    var event = Render(app)
    if (event != nil) { event() }
    return true
}

while (updateUI()) {}
```

---

## 7. Easing Functions nos Keyframes

```sp
var UI = 1

function triggerBounce() {
    Animate("box", {
        "duration": 0.9,
        "loop": false,
        "easing": "ease-out-bounce",   // também: "ease-out-elastic", "ease-in-out-cubic"
        "keyframes": [
            { "time": 0.0, "height": 20 },
            { "time": 1.0, "height": 100 }
        ]
    })
}

function updateUI() {
    var app = Flex(
        direction="column",
        gap=20.0,
        align="center",
        children=[
            Button(label="Bounce!", width=150.0, height=40.0, onClick=triggerBounce),
            Border(id="box", width=150.0, height=20.0, color="#8B5CF6FF")
        ]
    )
    var event = Render(app)
    if (event != nil) { event() }
    return true
}

while (updateUI()) {}
```

---

## Resumo das Novas APIs

| Função | Parâmetros principais |
|---|---|
| `Card(...)` | `gradientFrom`, `gradientTo`, `gradientDir`, `shadowBlur`, `shadowColor`, `shadowOffsetX`, `shadowOffsetY`, `glowColor`, `children` |
| `Badge(...)` | `count`, `label`, `color`, `width`, `height` |
| `Tag(...)` | `label`, `color`, `height` |
| `Stepper(...)` | `steps`, `current`, `labels`, `width`, `height` |
| `Spinner(...)` | `id`, `width`, `height`, `thickness`, `color` |
| `Notify(msg, type)` | `"success"` \| `"error"` \| `"warning"` \| `"info"` |

### Easing functions disponíveis

- `"linear"` (padrão)
- `"ease-in-quad"`
- `"ease-out-quad"`
- `"ease-in-out"` / `"ease-in-out-cubic"`
- `"ease-out-bounce"`
- `"ease-out-elastic"`
